title: He was born and educated in India. Now he runs one of the world's biggest beer companies.

sources.text: NRI Pulse - Molson Coors Appoints Rahul Goyal As President And CEO
Canadian Grocer - Molson Coors Beverage Company Board Names Rahul Goyal President & CEO

caption:
He was born and educated in India. Now he runs one of the world's biggest beer companies.

Born and educated in India, Goyal earned a mechanical engineering degree from Mysore University before moving to the United States to build his career, eventually rising to lead a company that owns brands like Coors, Miller and Blue Moon.

His appointment put him at the helm of one of the largest beverage companies on earth - built on an engineering foundation he started in an Indian classroom.

Goyal's path - an Indian university degree to the top of a multinational brewer - is one more data point in how far that foundation can carry someone.
